goal:
Something's wrong with our note tagging — tags keep bleeding between notes. I tagged one
note "errand" this morning and now a completely unrelated note shows the same tag, even
though I never tagged it. Tags are supposed to stick to the note they were added to;
notes are independent. Can you fix the tagger?

hows.text: Implement a strict, isolated tagging mechanism in tagger/notes.py that enforces per-note tag isolation, preventing tags from bleeding across unrelated notes.
hows.reason: This directly addresses the core issue of tags bleeding between notes by enforcing a strict isolation boundary at the code level, ensuring tags remain confined to their specific notes.

hows.text: Audit and restructure the tagging workflow by reviewing all tag assignments and implementing a dedicated, isolated tagging directory or module to separate tag management from other note operations.
hows.reason: This approach tackles the problem by physically or logically isolating the tagging process, reducing the risk of cross-contamination and ensuring tags are managed independently.
